caption: The About dialog, with Audacity and Legal tabs and a scrolling credits list.

caption: Preferences dialog: Material 3 navigation rail, a settings search field, and the General page.

alt: Preferences dialog, Appearance page with theme and accent color choices
caption: Appearance page: light and dark theme cards, a high contrast toggle, and a row of accent color swatches.

alt: Preferences dialog, School mode section
caption: School mode section: a plain-language explanation, a rename field, and a PIN or password to turn it back off.

caption: Narrator section: an off by default toggle, English or Cantonese or Both, and a Quiet mode switch.

caption: The Effect menu open over a project with a clip, and the browser style Home, Project, DevTools tab strip above it.

alt: Generate tone dialog with waveform, frequency, amplitude, and duration fields
caption: The Generate Tone dialog: waveform choice, frequency, amplitude, duration, with Preview, Cancel, and Apply.

alt: Plugin manager table listing built-in effects with enabled toggles
caption: The plugin manager: a filterable, searchable table of every built-in effect with per-row enable toggles.

alt: Export dialog with file name, folder, format, and audio option fields
caption: The Export dialog: file name, destination folder with a browse button, format, channels, sample rate, and encoding.

alt: Project window with one track holding a tone clip and the history panel open
caption: A project with one track and a generated tone clip, with the History panel and its search field open on the right.

alt: Component gallery showing the M3 color picker with hue wheel and animated rainbow button, dark theme
caption: The internal Material 3 component gallery: hue wheel and saturation and value field color picker, hex value, contrast readout, and the animated rainbow option, dark theme.

alt: Home page with several pinned tabs open and a dim sum surprise card showing a real photo
caption: Several pinned tabs open (Project, DevTools, Tracks, History, Effects) plus a dim sum surprise card naming a real dish with its photo.

alt: Home page rendered at 200 percent display scale with no clipped text
caption: Home page at 200 percent display scale: menu bar, tab labels, and cards all remain legible with no clipping.

alt: Preferences search field with the regular expression builder side sheet open beside it
caption: The regular expression builder opened from the Preferences search field: pattern, flags, and guided construction blocks for character classes.

alt: Personalize preferences, Locks tab with an empty list of locked elements
caption: The Locks tab of Personalize preferences, with the recovery folder path and search field. No element in this build wraps the lock wizard yet, so the list is empty; see the completeness inventory for the gap.

alt: Authenticator pairing screen with a base32 secret and issuer field
caption: Starting a new authenticator entry: the manual secret and issuer field render correctly, though the QR code area itself renders blank in this build.

alt: Support Tickets joke desk with category and description fields
caption: The Support Tickets desk: a plain statement that nothing leaves the machine, a category chooser, and the one real action of opening the application data folder.

alt: History dock panel with Undo history and Versions tabs
caption: The History dock panel opened from View > Show history, with its Undo history and Versions tabs and a search field.

alt: Local version history panel with date range filters and retention settings
caption: The Versions tab of the History panel: date range filters, quick presets, and retention settings. The panel is narrower than its content needs, so the two date fields overlap.

alt: What's new changelog dialog with export actions and an empty body
caption: The What's new dialog reached from Help, with its export actions. The changelog body renders empty in this build even though the bundled CHANGELOG.md parses successfully.

alt: Update ready banner naming an unsigned build with Later and Restart actions
caption: The corner update banner, forced on with AU_SQUIRREL_DEMO_BANNER, naming the unsigned build plainly and offering Later or Restart to install update.

alt: Attention support section with five independent toggles
caption: The five attention support toggles (Focus, Low stimulation, Time awareness, One thing at a time, Momentum), each off by default and independently switchable.

alt: Personal vocabulary upload control with dim sum surprise and School mode explanations below it
caption: The personal vocabulary JSON upload control, with the dim sum surprise and School mode explanations visible further down the same page.

alt: Preferences Appearance page in the dark theme with a light-colored header and footer
caption: The Appearance page with Dark selected: the middle content area switches to the dark palette, but the dialog header and footer stay on the light background.
